method: NumPy only decode NPZ to Python lists. Independent scalar normalized powers and math.fsum trapezoids for tau, independent unnormalized power integral for Dforce, independent W/endpoint storage for Dport. No W5 script import/execute.
tau: For P=max|F|>0: sum dt/2*((absF_i/P)^p+(absF_j/P)^p), computed directly from force samples; never Dforce/(bP^p). tau units seconds, not threshold duration.
pair_scope: All24 same Case/Story eight-device groups, all28 unordered pairs per group=672. Orient larger peak first, exact ties keep smaller numeric Link first. Strict inverse=(P_i>P_j and E_i<E_j); exact P/energy ties counted separately, no tuned tolerance.
log_identity: For positive P,tau,Dforce,Dport: log(Dport_i/Dport_j)=p log(P_i/P_j)+log(tau_i/tau_j)+log((Dport_i/Dforce_i)/(Dport_j/Dforce_j)); undefined for nonpositive arguments.
comparison_tolerance: energy and tau numeric: abs1e-12+rel1e-10; logs abs1e-11; not engineering acceptance or continuous error bound. Controller text and counts exact.
semantics_checks: Synthetic algorithm cases only: all-zero force => P=0, tau undefined not forced0, Dforce0; constant positive force => tau=T; exact peak ties with unequal energy not inversions; all three quantities tied => zero logs/no inversion; energy ties with unequal peak not inversions; Dport<=0 makes log decomposition undefined. Do not merge synthetic cases with192 data.
outputs: Small independent192 device rows/672 pair diagnostics, semantics results, source SHA/run/audit report; no repeated full histories.
limits: Classical Lp and amplitude-duration identity; no new index, physical validation, design cause, high mode/transfer-path identification, full88 or input direction certification. W native, Dport fitted-storage conditional, Dforce model-derived.
